items.title_en: Pune Man Makes Seven Creepy Dolls Sit On Car’s Rear Dashboard: ‘Yeh Toh Aahat Ke Tatya Vinchu Ki Gaadi Hain
items.title_zh: 浦那人让七个令人毛骨悚然的玩偶坐在汽车后仪表板上：“Yeh Toh Aahat Ke Tatya Vinchu Ki Gaadi Hain”
items.summary_en: Tatya Vinchu, featuring in the 1993 Marathi film Zapatlela, was a devilish possessed puppet whose menacing eyes and shrill laughter gave many sleepless nights.
items.summary_zh: 塔蒂亚·文丘 (Tatya Vinchu) 在 1993 年马拉地语电影《萨帕特莱拉》(Zapatlela) 中饰演主角，她是一个被恶魔附身的木偶，她凶恶的眼神和尖利的笑声让她度过了许多个不眠之夜。
